text.description: The segments' text, one segment per line (the raw transcript when a custom prompt yields no segments).

segments.description: Segments in order, as the model wrote them: start and end in seconds, speaker label, text.

speakers.description: Speaker labels in order of first appearance.

truncated.description: True when max_new_tokens ran out before the model finished: the transcript stops early. Raise max_new_tokens and run again.
